description: Dakota HJ922, last of the HJ-serial Dakotas, long parked at AFS Belgaum (Sambre), reassembled in 2017 on the Air Force School grounds inside AFS Jorhat, windows sealed, good overall condition. Source warbirds.in (Jan 2020), bharat-rakshak.

MiG-21M C1585 displayed at 5 Air Force Hospital, Jorhat (hospital just south of the air base), replacing the historic MiG-21FL C779 which was removed to the IAF Museum Delhi. Source warbirds.in (Jan 2024, photos Sanjay Simha), bharat-rakshak.
